alate: Alate: head and pronotum reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, compound eyes purple-black, labrum and ocelli yellowish white, wings pale yellowish white. Head and pronotum bearing rather many rather long bristles, the bristles of the pronotum especially more numerous than those of the head, the body colour also deeper than that of the head.
soldier: Soldier: in the same colony about 90 per cent of individuals have the head longer than wide and oval, while a few are nearly circular with the width and length almost equal, differing only in the broader head and shorter postmentum, with no other obvious differences. Head, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellow, mandibles reddish brown, abdomen yellowish white. The sides of the fontanelle mostly with one bristle each, absent on one side in a few individuals; no hairs between the antennae and the fontanelle, the head almost hairless, the labrum with two apical hairs, the margin of the pronotum with only a few bristles and the disc hairless, the abdominal tergites with rather many rather long erect bristles. The elongate-oval head is widest at the basal third, the circular head widest at the middle, the lateral margins rounded out in both forms, the posterior margin rounded. Mandibles rather short and straight, their tips slightly curved; labrum distinctly longer than wide, reaching more than half the length of the closed mandibles; fontanelle tube rather short, the aperture visible in dorsal view, the fontanelle aperture nearly oval. Antennae with 14–15 segments: with 14 segments the third and fourth are almost equal, with 15 segments the third is especially short. In the elongate-oval form the waist of the postmentum lies between the widest part and the posterior margin, in the circular form the waist clearly at the posterior end, the waist in both being wider than the anterior margin. The middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum is a broad concavity, the posterior margin very indistinctly concave.
